checks.name: assistant_neutral_mcp_is_copy_only_and_rejects_invalid_local_inputs
checks.run:
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from factoryline.mcp_setup import McpSetupError, mcp_connection_config
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as raw:
    root = Path(raw)
    generic = mcp_connection_config(root, 'generic')
    codex = mcp_connection_config(root, 'codex')
    assert generic['marker'] == 'FACTORY_MCP_CONFIG_READY'
    assert set(generic['markers']) >= {'MCP_CLIENT_RENDERED', 'MCP_COMMAND_BOUND', 'MCP_COPY_ONLY', 'MCP_CLIENT_CONFIG_COPYABLE'}
    assert generic['connection']['args'] == ['mcp', 'serve', '--root', str(root.resolve())]
    assert all(value is False for value in generic['authority'].values()) and generic['writes'] is False
    assert codex['command_line'].startswith('codex mcp add code-factory -- factory mcp serve --root ')
    try:
        mcp_connection_config(root, 'remote')
    except McpSetupError as exc:
        assert exc.marker == 'MCP_CLIENT_REJECTED'
    else:
        raise AssertionError('unsupported client was accepted')
print('ASSISTANT_NEUTRAL_MCP_SMOKE_PASS')
